'''Mononobe Shrine''' (物部神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} derived from the {{ill|Ancient history|en|Ancient history|qid=Q41493|lt=Ancient}}{{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}}’s {{ill|Mononobe clan|en|Mononobe clan|qid=Q1755836|lt=Mononobe clan}}. Shrines bearing this name are distributed over a wide area from {{ill|Eastern Japan|ja|東日本}} to {{ill|Western Japan|de|Westjapan|ja|西日本|ko|서일본|ru|Западная Япония|uk|Західна Японія|zh|西日本|qid=Q1063946}}. Many of them enshrine as their main deities either {{ill|Umashimaji|ja|ウマシマジ|lt=Umasimaji|lt_ja=宇麻志摩遅命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Umashimaji}}, the first of the Mononobe clan, or {{ill|Nigihayahi|ja|ニギハヤヒ|lt=Nigihayahi|lt_ja=饒速日命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nigihayahi}}, the ancestral deity.
